question: Manoj crosses a 500 m long street in 5 minutes. What is his speed in km per hour?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed in m/s = 500 ÷ (5 × 60) = 500 ÷ 300 = 5/3 m/s

To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply directly by 18/5.

Speed in km/h = (5/3) × (18/5) = 18 ÷ 3 = 6 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 6 km/h.**
